description: This file contains the implementation of a MemoryBufferWriter struct that implements the IBufferWriter<byte> interface for managing a byte buffer, including methods for advancing the write position, and retrieving memory or span segments of the buffer.

classes.name: MemoryBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> for writing to a Memory<byte> buffer, with methods to advance the write position and retrieve memory or span segments.

methods.name: MemoryBufferWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer and setting the initial bytes written to zero.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Property returning the number of bytes written to the buffer.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Method to advance the current write position by a specified count, throwing an exception if it exceeds buffer capacity.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Method to retrieve a Memory<byte> segment starting from the current write position, with an optional size hint.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Method to retrieve a Span<byte> segment starting from the current write position, with an optional size hint.

methods.name: ThrowInsufficientCapacity
methods.description: Private method to throw an exception when there is insufficient capacity in the buffer.
